text:
maria: Heads up — customers hitting the old Accept-Version header are being routed correctly to v1, but quota and billing show charges against v2 for some requests. Anyone else seeing mismatched model_version in telemetry?
kevin: Hmm, saw a few alerts. Is this only when Accept-Version is present or also when clients omit it?
sanjay: Quick signal check: routing.fallback.count spiked when router reverted to default branch during the CDN config change this morning. I suspect header normalization in the edge mux is rewriting the version header.
emily: Can you paste the header examples?
sanjay: Example from packet capture: `Accept-Version: v1` becomes `accept-version: v1` at the mux, and our routing rule matches case-sensitively in the router. Then a later normalizer maps it to canonical `version=v2` for the model selection.
maria: So we route v1 but the model selector metric `api.request.model_version` is set to v2 later? that would explain billing.
josh: Ops bot posted the rollout earlier: `deploy-bot: rollout v2-router 2026-03-17T10:12Z succeeded` — could be a change in header parsing in the v2-router.
ops-bot: infra-alert: INF-3456 created for routing header normalization discrepancy.
kevin: Short term mitigation: add a pre-routing hook that captures the raw Accept-Version header into `request.meta.client_version` before any normalization so quota uses the original. Patch should be tiny.
emily: Agree. Also we should add telemetry decorrelation: emit both `api.request.client_declared_version` and `api.request.effective_model_version` so we can detect divergence.
sanjay: Proposed rollout: patch edge-mux -> staging -> 5% canary on v2-router -> monitor `routing.fallback.count` and `quota.charge.model_version` for 30m. If green, promote.
maria: Can we also surface a console banner for customers on v1 explaining deprecation and that quotas may appear as v2 until the fix? Keep it subtle.
josh: UX note: the console banner should include a link to the compatibility page and a toggle to opt into the v2 migration preview. Don't block customers; just informative.
kevin: I'll open a PR for the pre-routing header capture. Draft title: "edge: preserve raw Accept-Version for quota/telemetry (INF-3456)". Assigning to me+sanjoy for review.
emily: Also adding an alert: if `sum(routing.fallback.count{window="5m"}) / sum(api.request.count{window="5m"}) > 0.01` then page eng-platform and infra.
sanjay: I'll add the alert and a Grafana panel for side-by-side `client_declared_version` vs `effective_model_version`.
maria: Can we add a short-term shim in SDKs to stop sending Accept-Version header when using older clients? That might be less ideal but reduces surface.
josh: SDK team prefers not to ship a revert. Better to fix server-side quickly.
kevin: Timeline: PR today, staging rollout tonight, canary tomorrow morning. I'll post PR link in this thread when ready.
emily: Thanks — and please add regression test that ensures `quota.charge.model_version` is computed from `client_declared_version` when present.
maria: Great. Assigning INF-3456 -> milestone v2-compat-patch. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
kevin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/edge/compare/patch-accept-version (WIP)
sanjay: Noted. Will validate telemetry mapping once PR is up.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary scheduled for 2026-03-18T08:00Z (5%)
maria: I'll draft the console banner text and share.
kevin: Updating ticket with rollout plan and test checklist.
emily: Closing loop: once canary shows <0.1% divergence for 2 hours we can promote.
josh: Add a note to the SDK changelog to mention header negotiation behavior and the deprecation timeline.
maria: Thanks team. Follow-ups in INF-3456 and the PR.
